newsitem.title: USA: TETCO south Tx. gas maintenance begins Sat.
newsitem.headline: TETCO south Tx. gas maintenance begins Sat.

text.p: Panenergy Corp will limit natural gas flows for four days beginning Saturday on two Texas Eastern lines in south Texas due to scheduled maintenance, the company said Friday.

"Basically what it means is that about half of the gas leaving south Texas will not flow this weekend," a company spokesman said, noting the outage most likely will not affect prices since demand is weak in the Northeast.
Normal deliveries are expected to resume on Wednesday.
The company could not immediately comment on the total volumes that would be affected by the outage.

All south Texas deliveries upstream of the Houston Ship Channel between Angleton and Mont Belvieu, Tx., on Line 16, and all deliveries from Provident City to Blessing, Tx., on Line 17 will be cut to zero by 0700 CDT Saturday, he said.
The first maintenance project on Line 16 involves the replacement of road crossings for a Texas highway project within the city of Pasadena, Tx. Gas will be shut in on Line 17 due to pipe repairs.
Natural gas spot prices in south Texas were at least five cents softer today in the mid-$2.30s.
Texas Eastern Transmission, which serves northeastern markets, is a subsidiary of Panenergy Corp.
